mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain high interest rates and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in labor force (PAYEMS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% in one month signal wage-push inflation, triggering Federal Reserve rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and CPIAUCSL increase by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE below 4.0%), the Federal Reserve tightens monetary policy to prevent overheating, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1100 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1.0% and 0.5% respectively over three months signals recession risk, triggering negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1.0% and GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline by the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A labor force level above 145 million (PAYEMS) signals strong economic conditions, boosting corporate earnings expectations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above 145 million.

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds rate above 2.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates for equity valuation and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%.
